sections.heading: About Circle of Song
sections.html:
Ages: Infants to age 5, with adult

Circle of Song is the original class that started it all at Sunflower, over 30 years ago!

This fun-filled family sing-along bonds caregivers, children, and friends through music. Enjoy live guitar and ukulele, dancing with colorful silks, storytelling, puppets, percussion instruments and a repertoire of songs from around the world.

Classes will meet on Mondays, 8:30–9:15 am OR Tuesdays, 8:30–9:15 am.

sections.heading: Parents sing Circle’s praises
sections.html: “Circle of Song is the most wonderful mommy and me group. My son is now 21, but I can still picture him dancing with the lovely colored silks, rattling a tambourine or egg shaker. I also remember that it was the one public place I felt completely safe and comfortable breastfeeding, without the anxiety of offending. Circle of Song brings back joyful memories…”

sections.heading: Interested in joining us for the 2026–27 school year? You can still apply!
sections.html: While our official application period has ended, we encourage interested families to submit an application using the button below. If space is currently available, we’ll be in touch with next steps. If a program is full, your child will be added to the waitlist, and we will call or email you when a spot becomes available.
